grounding.states: In soccer, Lionel Messi is the pick for GOAT, and recent coverage has him pulling ahead of Ronaldo in the debate
grounding.from: Most recent coverage leans toward Lionel Messi as the GOAT. ... The Korea Times (July 13, 2026) said ... has strengthened the view that he has edged ahead in the GOAT debate.

grounding.states: Messi has eight Ballon d'Or wins, compared with Ronaldo's five
grounding.from: Trophy counts: Messi has eight Ballons d'Or, compared to Ronaldo's five.

grounding.states: In American football, Tom Brady is still the usual GOAT pick, with 7 Super Bowl wins
grounding.from: Tom Brady is still widely treated as the NFL GOAT. He has 7 Super Bowl wins (7-3 all-time)

grounding.states: Patrick Mahomes is the main challenger to Brady and fans remain divided
grounding.from: Patrick Mahomes is the main challenger. ... Fans remain divided.

value.answer: Depends which football you mean. For soccer I'd go with Messi: he has eight Ballon d'Or wins to Ronaldo's five, and the latest coverage has him edging ahead in the GOAT debate. For American football it's still Tom Brady, with 7 Super Bowl wins, though Mahomes is the one closing in and fans are split.
